title: Quantitative Aptitude is NOT just Math!
description: The objective of Quantitative Aptitude is NOT just Math! is to equip 2nd and 3rd-year students with a deeper understanding of aptitude beyond just mathematical calculations, preparing them for placements and competitive exams. Through an engaging and interactive masterclass led by Mr. Sharad Awasthi, an esteemed IIT BHU & IIM Lucknow alumnus, students will learn how to think strategically and solve problems efficiently. The session aims to demystify aptitude, transforming it from a mere numerical exercise into a skill that enhances logical reasoning, decision-making, and smart problem solving. With real-world insights, practical strategies, and expert guidance, this event will empower students with the confidence and techniques needed to excel in their careers.

title: Game of Code-2.0
description: The objective of this event is to engage participants in a challenging and interactive problem-solving competition. The event is designed to test participants' logical thinking, teamwork, and cryptographic skills as they work together to decipher a given password. The ultimate goal is to create a fun, educational, and competitive environment where participants can apply their analytical abilities in real-time scenarios.

title: Break The Pass
description: The main objective is to promote technology and innovation to improve lives, solve social challenges and enhance human capacity. Encourage education and knowledge sharing in technology-related areas to enable individuals and communities to acquire the skills and knowledge needed to succeed in the digital age. To foster collaboration and networking among practitioners, researchers, entrepreneurs and interested parties to exchange ideas, share resources and promote joint technological advancement.
